ckm_case.criterion: RMSE <= 0.020 is required for CALIBRATED; otherwise the calibration claim is QUARANTINED/ACTION_REQUIRED.

baseline.purpose: descriptive comparator on the same observed curve; not an eGi calibration claim

constrained_by_CKM: diffusion trajectory under the observed adoption encoding
identifiability.reason: CKM adoption dates do not record local tests, receipt strength, contradiction events, quarantine, or mutation lineage.

post_quarantine_protocol: retain the failed calibration receipt and parameters unchanged
do not tune eGi parameters against the same held-out curve
select a new case or a new held-out partition before revising parameters
any structural extension is a new model variant and requires a new preregistration

policy_decision.decision: Do not tune eGi parameters against the same CKM curve; retain the failed receipt unchanged and move to a new case.
policy_decision.reason: CKM is adoption-only and cannot identify kappa, mutation, receipt strength, external verification, or contradiction detection.

positive_control.purpose: Distinguish a discriminating harness from a harness that quarantines every candidate.
positive_control.promotion_rule: A known-good synthetic eGi curve must pass the preregistered threshold and beat the Bass comparator.

bootstrap.method: paired bootstrap over the 17 observed points
bootstrap.finding_rule: The eGi-minus-Bass RMSE delta is comparative evidence only when the 90% interval excludes zero.

anchors.event: Marshall/Armstrong/McGechie/Glancy attempt to fulfill Koch postulates
Nobel Prize awarded to Marshall and Warren

h_pylori_case.model_gap: observed supersession/displacement is not represented by the current Q-only vocabulary

next_case_goal.reason: The current datasets are adoption-only; closing identification of eGi-specific parameters requires a mechanism-observing dataset with tests, contradictions, quarantine, mutation lineage, or receipt strength.
next_case_goal.not_claimed: H. pylori or CKM does not identify kappa, mutation, receipt strength, external verification, or contradiction detection.

external_ground_truth_control.purpose: Discriminate models using data generated by a known process external to eGi; this is not a round-trip of the candidate under test.
external_ground_truth_control.promotion_rule: Bass must recover the preregistered p and q within tolerance and have lower RMSE than the fixed eGi candidate.

symmetric_control.purpose: Test whether the same harness discriminates both known Bass and known eGi-generating processes using noisy observations.
symmetric_control.promotion_rule: Bass must beat fitted eGi on Bass-generated data and fitted eGi must beat fitted Bass on eGi-generated data. Both directions are required for a bidirectional discrimination claim.
symmetric_control.off_grid_purpose: Ensure the fitter must select the nearest registered grid node rather than trivially recovering a grid-aligned truth.
